scientific_scope_status: Actually fit independent native polynomial programs G_i of degree<=D on F_p^n, p>2(D+1), while each fixed real basis source f_i remains available for its own fresh guards. Let C_r mean all guards through the stopped cohort match and e_i=disagreement(f_i,G_i). The joint bound is Pr[C_r AND sum_i e_i>eta]<=exp(-q*eta). On C_r outside that bad event, the common error union has mass<=eta and all actual/program linear combinations agree outside it simultaneously. Rejected cohorts receive no certificate. For an accepted cohort outside the bad event, after old sources expire, actual random-line correction on a new source within tau of that family recovers its coefficients using r(D+1)L source values when eta+tau<=1/[8(D+1)]. New tolerant target guards retain open-world soundness; useful coverage remains conditional.
